title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第一章、菜市血衣

    一千年前的京城，一个普通的冬日早上。
    天刚亮，地上结着冰，赶早卖菜的人三三两两推着小车向城西的菜市场走去。突然，有人指着菜市场的大门上方惊叫：“那……是什么？”人群抬头望去，只见门头之上有个白色的人影正在冷风中摆动，像是幽灵。
    人群惊叫散开，有胆大的走到前面伸头看了看，看清后叫道：“就是件衣服！”然后爬上门头，将那挂在半空里的衣服拿了下来。
    是件白色大衣，质地优良，但胸前全是血，这是件血衣。衣服背面用血写着一行字，卖菜的人大多不识字，有个发须全白的老人大着胆子试着读道：“想……救八王爷……，非包……拯……不可。”
    人群立刻发出一片惊叫，这血衣是谁的？八王爷，包大人，这两个人都是大好人，他们怎么了？
    半小时后，开封府大门大开，包拯骑着快马出了门。五分钟前，他接到皇帝一道密令，命他立刻赶往八王爷府。
    八王爷府门口已有人守候，包拯认识，都是皇宫里的侍卫，看来皇帝已经到了。
    进了门，大厅里站着四个人，正围在一起看地上的一件血衣。包拯还没来得及说话，目光就被地上的衣服吸引住了。那四人里有人回头看了看包拯，这人二十岁左右，正是皇帝赵真。
    “包拯，你来了，送密令给你的人可把事情说清楚了？”皇帝问道。
    “说清楚了，我都知道了。”包拯回答。
    这时另外的三个人也都回了头，包拯全认识。他们是皇宫侍卫总管卫宁、太监总管张怀和八王爷府总管福康。
    “卫大人，这就是西市的那件血衣？”包拯问。
    卫宁答道：“是的，下面的人接到报案后第一时间就将衣服收了过来，然后交到了我这里。”
    包拯再问王府总管福康：“确定这是八王爷的衣服？”
    福康的眼睛红红的，一看就是哭了很久了。他跪倒在地，大哭着说：“是的，这是王爷昨天出门时穿的衣服，是我给他换上的。包大人，求您一定要把我们王爷救回来！我们王爷是好人，这是什么人要绑架王爷啊，这衣服上的血……他们对王爷做了什么……”他越哭越大声，到后面就说不下去了。
    皇帝微微皱眉，他的右眉上方有条淡淡的伤痕，一皱眉那条伤痕就显得特别清楚。他说：“绑匪指明要包拯来救八王爷，说明他们的目的在包拯身上，八王爷暂时是安全的。你不要哭了，起来再把事情经过好好和包拯说一说，让包拯理一理其中的线索。”
fullText.traditional:
第一章、菜市血衣

    一千年前的京城，一個普通的冬日早上。
    天剛亮，地上結著冰，趕早賣菜的人三三兩兩推著小車向城西的菜市場走去。突然，有人指著菜市場的大門上方驚叫：“那……是什麼？”人群抬頭望去，只見門頭之上有個白色的人影正在冷風中擺動，像是幽靈。
    人群驚叫散開，有膽大的走到前面伸頭看了看，看清後叫道：“就是件衣服！”然後爬上門頭，將那掛在半空裡的衣服拿了下來。
    是件白色大衣，質地優良，但胸前全是血，這是件血衣。衣服背面用血寫著一行字，賣菜的人大多不識字，有個髮鬚全白的老人大著膽子試著讀道：“想……救八王爺……，非包……拯……不可。”
    人群立刻發出一片驚叫，這血衣是誰的？八王爺，包大人，這兩個人都是大好人，他們怎麼了？
    半小時後，開封府大門大開，包拯騎著快馬出了門。五分鐘前，他接到皇帝一道密令，命他立刻趕往八王爺府。
    八王爺府門口已有人守候，包拯認識，都是皇宮裡的侍衛，看來皇帝已經到了。
    進了門，大廳裡站著四個人，正圍在一起看地上的一件血衣。包拯還沒來得及說話，目光就被地上的衣服吸引住了。那四人裡有人回頭看了看包拯，這人二十歲左右，正是皇帝趙真。
    “包拯，你來了，送密令給你的人可把事情說清楚了？”皇帝問道。
    “說清楚了，我都知道了。”包拯回答。
    這時另外的三個人也都回了頭，包拯全認識。他們是皇宮侍衛總管衛寧、太監總管張懷和八王爺府總管福康。
    “衛大人，這就是西市的那件血衣？”包拯問。
    衛寧答道：“是的，下面的人接到報案後第一時間就將衣服收了過來，然後交到了我這裡。”
    包拯再問王府總管福康：“確定這是八王爺的衣服？”
    福康的眼睛紅紅的，一看就是哭了很久了。他跪倒在地，大哭著說：“是的，這是王爺昨天出門時穿的衣服，是我給他換上的。包大人，求您一定要把我們王爺救回來！我們王爺是好人，這是什麼人要綁架王爺啊，這衣服上的血……他們對王爺做了什麼……”他越哭越大聲，到後面就說不下去了。
    皇帝微微皺眉，他的右眉上方有條淡淡的傷痕，一皺眉那條傷痕就顯得特別清楚。他說：“綁匪指明要包拯來救八王爺，說明他們的目的在包拯身上，八王爺暫時是安全的。你不要哭了，起來再把事情經過好好和包拯說一說，讓包拯理一理其中的線索。”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ men wáng ye shì hǎo rén zhè shì shén me rén yào bǎng jià wáng ye a zhè yī fu shang de xiě tā men duì wáng ye zuò le shén me
sentences.english: Our prince is a good man. Who would want to kidnap the prince? The blood on this garment … What did they do to the prince?”

sentences.simplified: 他越哭越大声，到后面就说不下去了。
sentences.traditional: 他越哭越大聲，到後面就說不下去了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yuè kū yuè dà shēng dào hòu miàn jiù shuō bú xià qù le
sentences.english: He cried louder and louder until he couldn’t speak anymore.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝微微皱眉，他的右眉上方有条淡淡的伤痕，一皱眉那条伤痕就显得特别清楚。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝微微皺眉，他的右眉上方有條淡淡的傷痕，一皺眉那條傷痕就顯得特別清楚。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì wēi wēi zhòu méi tā de yòu méi shàng fāng yǒu tiáo dàn dàn de shāng hén yí zhòu méi nà tiáo shāng hén jiù xiǎn de tè bié qīng chu
sentences.english: The emperor frowned slightly. There was a faint scar above his right eyebrow, and when he frowned the scar became particularly noticeable.

sentences.simplified: 他说：“绑匪指明要包拯来救八王爷，说明他们的目的在包拯身上，
sentences.traditional: 他說：“綁匪指明要包拯來救八王爺，說明他們的目的在包拯身上，
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō bǎng fěi zhǐ míng yào bāo zhěng lái jiù bā wáng ye shuō míng tā men de mù dì zài bāo zhěng shēn shang
sentences.english: He said, “The kidnappers specifically asked for Bao Zheng to rescue the Eighth Prince, which indicates that their target is Bao Zheng.

sentences.simplified: 八王爷暂时是安全的。
sentences.traditional: 八王爺暫時是安全的。
sentences.pinyin: bā wáng ye zàn shí shì ān quán de
sentences.english: The Eighth Prince is safe for now.

sentences.simplified: 你不要哭了，起来再把事情经过好好和包拯说一说，让包拯理一理其中的线索。”

sentences.english: Stop crying, and get up and explain the whole situation to Bao Zheng clearly, so he can sort out the clues.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: A Bloodstained Garment in the Market
A thousand years ago in the capital city, an ordinary winter’s morning.
The day had just dawned, and the ground was covered with frost.
People selling vegetables early in the morning were pushing their carts in twos and threes towards the market in the city’s west.
Suddenly, someone pointed on top of the gate to the market and screamed, “What … is that?”
The crowd raised their heads to look, only to see a white figure swaying in the cold wind above the gate, like a ghost.
The crowd screamed and scattered. The brave ones stepped forward and craned their necks to look.
After seeing clearly, they shouted, “It’s just a piece of clothing!”
Then they climbed up to the top of the gate and took down the garment that was hanging in mid-air.
It was a big white overcoat of excellent quality, but the front was covered in blood. This was a bloodstained garment.
On the back of the garment was a line of text written in blood. The vegetable sellers were mostly illiterate.
An old man with completely white hair and beard bravely tried to read it: “Want … to save the Eighth Prince … must be Bao … Zheng.”
The crowd immediately let out a gasp of shock. Whose bloodstained garment was this?
The Eighth Prince, Lord Bao, these two people are both very good people. What happened to them?
Half an hour later, the gates of Kaifeng Mansion swung open, and Bao Zheng rode out on a fast horse.
Five minutes previously, he had received a secret order from the emperor, ..
.. instructing him to immediately hurry to the Eighth Prince’s mansion.
At the entrance of the Eighth Prince’s mansion, there were already people standing guard.
Bao Zheng recognized them. They were all imperial palace bodyguards. It seemed that the emperor had already arrived.
Upon entering the gate, there were four people standing in the hall, gathered around and looking at a bloodstained garment on the floor.
Before Bao Zheng could speak, his gaze was drawn to the garment on the floor.
One of the four people turned around and looked at Bao Zheng.
This person, around twenty years old, was Emperor Zhao Zhen.
“Bao Zheng, you have arrived. Did the person who delivered the secret order explain everything clearly?” the emperor asked.
“He explained it clearly. I have understood it all,” Bao Zheng replied.
At this moment, the other three people also turned their heads. Bao Zheng recognized all of them.
They were chief imperial bodyguard, Wei Ning, chief eunuch, Zhang Huai, and the chief steward of the Eighth Prince’s mansion, Fu Kang.
“Lord Wei, is this the bloodstained garment from the West Market?” Bao Zheng asked.
Wei Ning replied, “Yes, after receiving the report, the subordinates immediately collected the garment and brought it to me.”
Bao Zheng asked the chief steward of the prince’s mansion, Fu Kang, “Can you confirm that this is the Eighth Prince’s garment?”
Fu Kang’s eyes were red, clearly showing that he had been crying for a long time.
He fell to his knees, crying and saying, “Yes, this is the garment the prince wore when he went out yesterday.
I was the one who helped him change into it. Lord Bao, I beg you, you must save our prince!
Our prince is a good man. Who would want to kidnap the prince? The blood on this garment … What did they do to the prince?”
He cried louder and louder until he couldn’t speak anymore.
The emperor frowned slightly. There was a faint scar above his right eyebrow, and when he frowned the scar became particularly noticeable.
He said, “The kidnappers specifically asked for Bao Zheng to rescue the Eighth Prince, which indicates that their target is Bao Zheng.
The Eighth Prince is safe for now.
Stop crying, and get up and explain the whole situation to Bao Zheng clearly, so he can sort out the clues.”
